Definition: a primary verb; to swell out, i.e. (by implication) to gush:--send forth.
BiblicalUsage: The word brýō is to swell out, to gush forth. You meet it in James, where it does exactly what it sounds like it should do.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that brýō shows God wastes no words — every word He gives, including this one, belongs where it is.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
